dedupe_keys.name: us data center map dcmap us facilities and construction pipeline

description: The US Data Center Map at dcmap.us tracks data centre facilities and projects across the United States, from operating sites to those planned, under construction, paused or inactive. As of its August 2026 update it lists 4,998 facilities and projects, of which 4,779 are current: 3,359 operational, 378 under construction and 1,042 planned, with 69 paused and 150 inactive or historical; it totals 374.7 GW of reported or announced power for current records and 318.6 GW planned or under construction. Each record carries the company or brand, location on an interactive map, the published power figure, project scope and build stage, and the site publishes a pipeline tracker for AI and hyperscale construction and an application programming interface for automated access. Data are updated monthly. Coverage: the United States. Format and access: free interactive map and pipeline pages with an API; licence and data sources are described on separate methodology and developer pages, not read. Caveats: the operator is not named on the home page; power figures are as announced by developers and include speculative projects, so planned totals greatly exceed what is likely to be built. Simulation uses: scenarios of future data-centre load and its location for grid and water planning, and hazard exposure of planned sites. Related records: the IM3 atlas and EPRI load projections cover existing sites and demand, and Data Center Watch tracks projects blocked by local opposition.
